LanguageData.NR_TransitionRumour: Forum rumour: the corporations are building something in their black labs. It has to do with consciousness, or with AI. Nobody outside knows which; the post that said so was deleted.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionRumourMsg: A rumour runs through the feed: the corporations are building something in their black labs. Nobody outside knows what.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionContact:
A message comes through a channel no fixer admits to owning. The sender calls themselves {0}: they used to work in a corporate black lab, and now they are running.

"You have heard the rumours. I will not tell you what they are building; I am not sure I understand it myself. Something to do with minds, or with machines that think. The pieces are kept in the labs. I sell coordinates. What you take out of there is your business."

{0} now waits in the Club as a guest: lab coordinates for {1} cyberdata and {2} silver.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderDesc: Used to work in a black lab and will not say on what. Sells the coordinates of labs where prototype schematics are kept. The labs have Black ICE, and the door asks for an advanced cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderBuyTip: A lab (a violet node) appears on the cyberspace map for {0} days; the letter says which hub it hangs on, and the hub is marked on the map. A clean dive may bring a prototype schematic (certain after two clean dives without one). The dive adds 15 Heat.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderPrintsTip: Prototype schematics taken out of the labs so far.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderRoleTip: Used to work in a corporate black lab.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderGuestTip: Not one of the Club's fixers: a guest who came in over a dead channel. Sells one thing only.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderLabActive: {0} on {1} is still waiting on the map.
LanguageData.NR_LabCodeNames: Lazarus,Ark,Elysium,Straylight,Glass Orchid,Silent Choir,Chrome Lotus,Zero Meridian,Neon Cathedral,Ghost Orchard,Paper Moon,Sleeping Saint,Mirror Abbey,Hollow Crown,Black Lantern,Sable Echo,Iron Lullaby,Velvet Static,Saint Kilda,Cold Harbor
LanguageData.NR_LabFound: {0} sends the coordinates: {1}, the violet node on {2}. They stay valid for {3} days; the hub is marked on the cyberspace map.\n\nBlack ICE, two forks; the door takes an advanced cyberdata. A clean exit may bring a prototype schematic.
LanguageData.NR_LabNoPrint: {0}: nothing taken out this time, but the logs point to the next lab.
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_1: From the files of {0}: "...kept talking forty minutes after. In the buffer. Asked for her cat. For the lawyers: continuity. Not survival. Continuity."
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_2: From the files of {0}: "Drift under 0.3%. Still dreams. The board wants a name for it. Marketing has one. Nobody in the room laughed."
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_3: From the files of {0}, a deleted message: "...if anyone finds this. The bodies stay. We keep them in the pods. The families were told nothing. Do not ask me what we"
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_4: From the files of {0}: "Frozen. Too many volunteers. The line out is full of people who do not want to come back. A liability, says the board. I would call it a door."
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintsAll: The fifth prototype fits the others. Together they describe a method: a mind moved out of the brain into the net, whole and awake. This is what the labs were building. The research "the Transition" can now be started.\n\nWhen it is done, a colonist with a cyberlink can cross into the net from a powered cyberpod. The body stays behind as an empty shell.
LanguageData.NR_TechprintDelivered: A techprint came out of the lab with the runner: look for it near the pod (or in a drop pod at the colony). Apply it at a research bench.
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintsAllPrints: The fifth prototype fits the others. Together they describe a method: a mind moved out of the brain into the net, whole and awake. This is what the labs were building: "the Transition".\n\nApply the techprints at a research bench, and the research can be started. When it is done, a colonist with a cyberlink can cross into the net from a powered cyberpod. The body stays behind as an empty shell.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionResearchPrints: Prototypes found: {0} / {1} (all are needed to start).
LanguageData.NR_TransitionResearchHidden: Something the corporations keep in their black labs. Follow the rumours in the net.
LanguageData.NR_PrototypeDesc: A prototype schematic taken out of a corporate black lab. Fragmentary on its own; five of them seem to fit together.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionResearchVague: Pieces of something the corporations develop in their black labs. It has to do with consciousness, or with AI; nobody outside knows. The pieces fit together only when all five are found.
LanguageData.NR_UploadBeginDesc: Moves this colonist's mind into the net. Takes {0} hours; the pod must stay closed and powered. Heat rises while it runs, and the corporations may send a purge team.\n\nOpens a list of every occupied pod on the map: tick who goes, and they all start together. When the mind is gone, the body quietly dies. This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionPick: Tick the colonists who cross over. They start together and finish together in {0} hours.
LanguageData.NR_UploadConfirm: {0} will leave the body for good and cross into the net. The upload takes {1} hours; opening the pod before the end may kill them.\n\nBegin the Transition?
LanguageData.NR_UploadProgressDesc: {0}'s mind is moving into the net. Do not open the pod.
LanguageData.NR_UploadInRun: {0} is out in the net: end the run first.
LanguageData.NR_UploadStarted: {0} begins the Transition: {1} hours in the pod.
LanguageData.NR_UploadBroken: The upload of {0} was torn off halfway. The mind snapped back into a body it had half left: a heavy Netsick, but alive.
LanguageData.NR_UploadBrokenDeath: The upload of {0} was torn off halfway. Half a mind came back, and it was not enough. {0} is dead.
LanguageData.NR_UploadDone:
The last packet goes through. {0} is in the net now: awake, whole, free of the body.

Their last words in the colony's channel: "{1}"

The pod opens. The body is empty now, and it stops, peacefully. Bury it: no one is inside.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_0: Leave the light on. I can see it from here.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_1: It is so quiet. Nothing hurts.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_2: Tell the others I made it.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_3: I can hear every server on the planet breathing.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_4: Do not wait for me. I am already everywhere.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_5: Feed the animals. I will check the logs.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_6: The body was only the first dive.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_7: I see the stars from the satellites. They are close.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_8: I am not gone. Just further away.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_10: It feels like waking up, not falling asleep.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_11: Keep my pod warm. Just in case.
LanguageData.NR_Epilogue:
The colony is quiet. The pods hum, empty, and somewhere in the net a small crew keeps running, without bodies, without end.

Those who crossed over:
{0}

You can end the story here, or play on: someone always wanders in to an empty base.
